text: The United States and United Kingdom together provided about 29.4% of the ODA Kenya received in 2015-2022: USD 7.07 billion of USD 24.06 billion (OECD DAC2a net disbursements, current USD). Note the 24.06 billion total sums 117 providers and includes about USD 1.47 billion from 39 private donors; excluding them, the share would be slightly higher (about 31.3%).
